verdict.rationale: Svelte documents its own type-checking tool: `sv check` reports JavaScript/TypeScript compiler errors across the project, and script blocks accept TypeScript via `lang="ts"`. No evidence states that this checking reaches template markup expressions rather than only script code, so the template-specific core of the story is unproven. missing for 10: explicit documentation that template expressions and bindings are type-checked, editor integration details for template type errors, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get compile-time type checking inside my component templates, not just script blocks

citations.quote: `sv check` finds errors and warnings in your project, such as: unused CSS, accessibility hints, JavaScript/TypeScript compiler errors
You can also check your code from the command line using npx sv check.
A `<script>` block contains JavaScript (or TypeScript, when adding the `lang="ts"` attribute)
